assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known unspecified atrial fibrillation
Diagnosis code I48.91 corresponds to unspecified atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Diagnosis code Z86.73 corresponds to personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring via CPT 93271 is indicated
The monitoring is indicated to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management
